name: GuestManifest
privacy_notes: Contains PII: guest names (salutation, firstName, lastName) and child ages. MUST NOT appear in on_discover or on_select.
Conveyed only to the fulfilling property and its supply system under purpose-bound consent.
Child ages used solely for rate eligibility and occupancy — not retained for profiling.
specialRequest may contain PII if traveller includes personal information.
consentArtifact must be present before this manifest is transmitted over the network.
